data.name: Nipan
data.gender_notes: Nipan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nipan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nipana' which means 'to shine' or 'to radiate'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to bring light and knowledge into the world. It is a powerful name that represents wisdom and enlightenment. The name Nipan carries the meaning “To Shine, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Nipan usually hope their child will grow to embody to shine, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Nipan is a spiritual name that represents the inner light of the soul. It is a name that encourages self-illumination and self-realization. It is a name that is often given to those who are on the spiritual path and are seeking enlightenment.
data.etymology: Nipan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “To Shine, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nipan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
